variables.input:
timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime), by: { cluster_name }
| fields cluster_name

timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }), by: { service }

0.content: **Cluster Overview**: The first stop. Nodes, roster, memory, CPU, network, and read/write TPS for the whole cluster. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

2.content:
### Aerospike Version

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (count_values()). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
count by ( build) (count_values by (build) ("build_numbers", (aerospike_node_up{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", }) ))
```

3.content:
### Alerts

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (Prometheus alert state (ALERTS) -- alerts are not in Dynatrace). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
count by (severity) (ALERTS{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace|$^", severity=~"warn|critical|info|error"}) 
```

4.content:
### Cluster Name

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (count_values()). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
#sum(aerospike_node_up{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"})
count by (cluster_name) (count_values by (cluster_name) ("cluster",aerospike_node_stats_cluster_size{cluster_name="$cluster"}))
```

5.title: Log Level
5.query:
timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_node_stats_pseudo_log_detail, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) }, rollup: avg), a1 = sum(aerospike_node_stats_pseudo_log_debug, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) }, rollup: avg)
| fieldsAdd details = a0[], debug = a1[]
| fieldsRemove a0, a1
| fields details = coalesce(details[-2], arrayLast(details)), debug = coalesce(debug[-2], arrayLast(debug))
5.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum (aerospike_node_stats_pseudo_log_detail{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node"})
sum (aerospike_node_stats_pseudo_log_debug{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node"})

6.title: Checkpoint
6.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:

7.title: Stop Writes / HWM Breached (total)
7.query:
timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_namespace_stop_writes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg), a1 = sum(aerospike_namespace_clock_skew_stop_writes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg), a2 = sum(aerospike_namespace_hwm_breached, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg)
| fieldsAdd stop_writes = a0[], clock_skew_stop_writes = a1[], hwm_breached = a2[]
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2
| fields stop_writes = coalesce(stop_writes[-2], arrayLast(stop_writes)), clock_skew_stop_writes = coalesce(clock_skew_stop_writes[-2], arrayLast(clock_skew_stop_writes)), hwm_breached = coalesce(hwm_breached[-2], arrayLast(hwm_breached))
7.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum(aerospike_namespace_stop_writes{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"})
sum(aerospike_namespace_clock_skew_stop_writes{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"})
sum(aerospike_namespace_hwm_breached{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"})

10.title: Migrations (Partitions) (total)
10.query:
timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_namespace_migrate_rx_partitions_remaining, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg), a1 = sum(aerospike_namespace_migrate_rx_partitions_active, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg), a2 = sum(aerospike_namespace_migrate_tx_partitions_remaining, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg), a3 = sum(aerospike_namespace_migrate_tx_partitions_active, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg)
| fieldsAdd rx_remaining = a0[], rx_active = a1[], tx_remaining = a2[], tx_active = a3[]

17.title: SC Namespaces
17.query:
timeseries value = avg(aerospike_namespace_strong_consistency, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(ns, array($namespace)) }), by: { cluster_name, ns, service, storage_engine }
| filter coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value)) > 0
| summarize value = count(), by: { ns } | fieldsAdd value = 1
| summarize value = count()
17.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
 count ( group by (ns) (aerospike_namespace_strong_consistency{ job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^"} > 0))

18.content:
### Observed Nodes (unique)

_Not available in Dynatrace yet ('and' between series). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
avg (
avg by (ns) (aerospike_namespace_pseudo_observed_nodes_size{ job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^"})
and
avg by (ns) (aerospike_namespace_strong_consistency{ job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}>0)
)
```

19.content:
### Roster size (unique)

_Not available in Dynatrace yet ('and' between series). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
(((avg by (ns) (aerospike_namespace_pseudo_roster_size{ job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}) 
!= 
scalar(avg (aerospike_namespace_pseudo_observed_nodes_size{ job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^"})))
)
and
avg by (ns) (aerospike_namespace_strong_consistency{ job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}>0)) == 0
```
